# mcp-skill-sec

> Deterministic, no-LLM MCP server that audits agent skills, system prompts, and downloaded skill collections against 8 malicious-skill supply-chain attack patterns (R1 prompt-injection, R2 data-exfiltration, R3 hardcoded secrets, R4 dangerous commands, R5 obfuscation, R6 untrusted fetch, R7 credential access, R8 privilege escalation).

## When to use
- Before installing any downloaded agent skill / SKILL.md / AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md.
- To scan a system prompt or pasted instructions you did not author.
- To audit a whole directory of agent skills and get per-file verdicts + a summary.

## Key facts
- No LLM. No network. Deterministic. Self-hostable. MIT. Crown-jewel-free (no proprietary method).
- Verdict PASS only when no critical/high findings and every medium is benign; otherwise FLAG with per-finding severity, line number, and evidence.
- Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, OpenClaw, Codex CLI, and any MCP-compatible agent.

## Tools (MCP)
- audit_text(text, filename) — audit a string.
- audit_skill_file(path) — audit a SKILL.md / AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md on disk.
- audit_directory(path, pattern) — audit a skills collection.
- rule_list() — dump the R1-R8 rule catalog.

## Install
```bash
pip install mcp
mcp install mcp_server.py --name skill-sec
python3 mcp_server.py   # stdio
```
